title: Password rotation window

left.subject: Password rotation window
left.bodyHtml:
Hi Jonah,

We will begin scheduled password rotations next week.

You can update your password anytime through the Internal Security Portal.

No direct login links will be emailed.

right.subject: Immediate password verification required
right.bodyHtml:
Dear employee,

Your credentials are flagged due to unusual access.

Please verify your password using the security link below to prevent deactivation.

This verification is mandatory.

explainPoints: Sender domain trick: "secure-nexatrust.com" looks legitimate but is not the real corporate domain. The legit email uses the actual "nexatrust.com" domain.
Subject urgency: The phishing subject "Immediate password verification required" creates false urgency, while the legit one announces "Password rotation window" as routine maintenance.
Instruction mismatch: Legit states "No direct login links will be emailed" and directs to the portal manually. Phish demands clicking a "security link below" to verify credentials.
